design_archetype: The Performance Pro & Modern Swiss Precision (2026 Clean SaaS)

theme_strategy.switching_mechanism: data-theme attribute or dark class on root element with CSS variable swapping

typography.font_family_primary: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

.civr-card.description: 2026 Cardless/Flat Surface transformation. Replaces heavy bordered boxes with clean background planes, crisp 1px borders, and ultra-light subtle shadows.

styles.transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease

.civr-btn.description: Button system with strict hierarchy: 1 primary action per screen context, quiet secondary/ghost for supporting actions.

.civr-input.description: Modern inset input fields with subtle hairline borders and crisp accent ring focus state.

styles.focus: border-color: var(--c-accent), box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-ring), outline: none

.civr-pill.description: Status badges and tag pills with soft background fills and high-contrast text.

.civr-table.description: Clean, cardless data table layout separated by hairlines.

styles.header_cell: padding: 0.75rem 1.0rem, font-size: 0.75rem (12px), text-transform: uppercase, font-weight: 600, color: var(--c-text-2), border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border), text-align: left
styles.body_cell: padding: 0.875rem 1.0rem, border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-hairline), color: var(--c-text)

.civr-seg.description: Segmented control container for view toggles or mode selections.

styles.item_styles: padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem, font-size: 0.8125rem (13px), font-weight: 500, color: var(--c-text-2), border-radius: var(--radius-sm), cursor: pointer, transition: all 0.15s ease
styles.item_active_styles: background-color: var(--c-surface-1), color: var(--c-text), font-weight: 600, box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)

PageTitle.description: Universal header component across all 35 pages.
PageTitle.layout: Flexbox layout (col on mobile, row on desktop), justify-between, items-start md:items-center, gap-4, pb-6, mb-6, border-b border-[var(--c-hairline)]

structure.right_actions: Flex group containing MAX 1 primary CTA button (.civr-btn-primary), overflow/secondary actions in quiet buttons or dropdown menu

SectionTabs.styles: display: flex, gap: 1.5rem (24px), border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border), margin-bottom: 1.5rem
SectionTabs.tab_item: padding-bottom: 0.75rem, font-size: 0.875rem (14px), font-weight: 500, color: var(--c-text-2), border-bottom: 2px solid transparent, transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease

page_shell_and_layout_rules.vertical_rhythm: gap-6 (24px) or gap-8 (32px) between major page sections
page_shell_and_layout_rules.cardless_deconstruction_pattern: Replace nested cards inside outer cards with flat full-bleed sections separated by 1px hairlines (`border-b border-[var(--c-hairline)]`). Maintain visual hierarchy through font weight and subtle surface tinting (`bg-[var(--c-surface-1)]` vs `bg-[var(--c-surface-2)]`) rather than boxing every single paragraph or detail item.
page_shell_and_layout_rules.mobile_sticky_action_bar: On mobile viewports (screen width < 768px), primary form submissions and call CTAs dock into a fixed bottom action bar (`fixed bottom-14 left-0 right-0 p-3 bg-[var(--c-surface-1)] border-t border-[var(--c-border)] z-40 backdrop-blur-md bg-opacity-90`) above the bottom nav.

dashboard.components: Wallet Balance Hero (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8), Quick Actions/Free Test Call Widget (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4), Active Numbers List (col-span-12), Recent Activity Table/Feed (col-span-12)

wizard.step_indicator: Horizontal step pill progress bar (Step 1: Purpose -> Step 2: Pick Number -> Step 3: Pay)
wizard.ai_callout_box: Emily AI Recommendation box styled with soft accent gradient border, AI icon badge, and instant 'Select Recommended Number' action.

list_page.top_bar: Search bar + Filter pill group + View switcher (grid/table) + Primary Action CTA
list_page.content: Hairline-separated card grid or compact table with inline quick actions

settings_tab_page.layout: SectionTabs header -> 2-column setting rows (Left: Title + Description, Right: Form Control / Switch Row)
settings_tab_page.switch_row_pattern: Flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-b border-[var(--c-hairline)]

form_page.layout: max-w-2xl mx-auto, single-column field stacked layout, gap-5
form_page.footer: Flex justify-end gap-3 pt-6 border-t border-[var(--c-hairline)]

table_page.layout: Filter header -> Full-width .civr-table with sticky header and pagination bar

two_pane_inbox.desktop_layout: grid grid-cols-12 h-[calc(100vh-140px)] rounded-xl border border-[var(--c-border)] overflow-hidden
two_pane_inbox.right_pane: col-span-8 bg-[var(--c-surface-subtle)] flex flex-col (Thread message view + Input composer)
two_pane_inbox.mobile_layout: Full width list; tapping conversation slides in full screen thread view

motion_and_micro_interactions.hover_transforms: hover:-translate-y-0.5 for actionable cards and primary buttons

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text and surface pairings meet WCAG 2.1 AA (min 4.5:1 for standard body, min 3:1 for large text/ui components)
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px interactive target areas on mobile screens
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_focus: Explicit focus-visible ring on all interactive elements using var(--c-ring)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="home-wallet-add-funds-button", data-testid="wizard-step-2-number-item", data-testid="messages-send-button").

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the exact CSS variable definitions provided under tokens_light and tokens_dark to the project root CSS file (e.g., cloudivr.css or index.css).
Update all shared CSS classes (.civr-card, .civr-btn, .civr-input, .civr-pill, .civr-table, .civr-seg, PageTitle, SectionTabs) to match the 2026 specs in this document.
Refactor PageTitle across all signed-in pages to strictly enforce 1 primary action button and move secondary actions into overflow/ghost buttons.
Eliminate nested boxes and replace them with flat hairline-separated sections to achieve a clean, calm, 2026 UX.
Ensure both Light and Dark modes render cleanly with high contrast.
Ensure data-testid attributes are preserved or added on all buttons, inputs, tabs, and actionable items across JS components.
